content.comment_body: Hello. If you are working in engineering software like TIA portal or [product_name] using LAD language, you can set i00 = 1 so that DB1.Status = 1, resulting in q00 = 1. (DB1.Status is a variable in DB1 that changes when you press a button on the PC). Is it possible to create similar data blocks in [product_name]?

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. [product_name] does not support data blocks or organization/function blocks. Instead, it has a dedicated memory area called VM memory for exchanging data with other controllers. For example, if an S7 controller accesses this data area, it is equivalent to data block 1 in S7. In a network project, you can use the connection list in [product_name] to directly write to or read from data blocks of other devices.
Thanks! That seems to be exactly what I need. Am I correct in understanding that with this table, I can read and write values of any elements within the circuit?

analysis.insight_summary: The user asks about emulating Data Block functionality from engineering software typically used with programmable controllers in [product_name] devices. The key finding is that [product_name] does not support native Data Blocks or related block types, but it offers a VM memory area for data exchange and an alternative method using the connection list for reading and writing circuit element values.
analysis.user_expectations: The user aims to create and modify data blocks or similar memory areas in [product_name] to enable reading and writing values of circuit elements, similar to what is done in other engineering environments.
